site.name: ZAIN LABS
site.claim: Engineering agentic AI, apps and media for DACH.
site.intro: One studio, five production lines. We turn researched ideas into working software, websites, mobile apps, films and music for businesses and audiences in Germany, Austria and Switzerland.

process.title: Research
process.text: Every product starts from a researched brief, not a hunch: market, users, regulation in DACH.

process.title: Specification
process.text: A written PRD with decisions, assumptions and open questions before the first line of code.

process.title: Build
process.text: Shared templates, agents and CI let each new product start at 60% instead of zero.

process.title: Evaluate
process.text: Tests, golden cases and human review gates. Nothing consequential happens without approval.

process.title: Launch
process.text: Shipped as a public demo, website, app or release, with metrics fed back into the next build.

streams.name: Software
streams.description: A reusable pipeline that turns researched ideas into PRDs and then into working agentic-AI products for DACH businesses: multi-agent workflows, ERP-connected automations, APIs and dashboards.

streams.name: Websites
streams.description: One generator for modern showroom and e-commerce sites: shared design system, content model and deploy pipeline, so a new product gets a site in a day.

streams.name: Mobile Apps
streams.tagline: iOS and Android from one codebase
streams.description: Cross-platform apps that reuse the website design system and the software back ends: navigation, auth, theming, offline cache and store release pipeline included.

streams.name: Studio
streams.description: A mostly automated, Linux-based studio toolbox for micro dramas, songs, albums and channel content for DACH audiences, from idea to script, storyboard, edit and release.

streams.name: Deep-Tech
streams.description: Long-horizon research and engineering intelligence across manufacturing, maintenance, supply chain, CAD and imaging, plus the market research behind every other stream.

projects.title: Mahn-Agent
projects.summary: Agentic dunning for DACH SMEs: finds overdue invoices, drafts German reminders, sends only with human approval.
description: Mahn-Agent connects to Odoo or ERPNext, matches incoming payments and decides which invoices need a Zahlungserinnerung, a Mahnung or a final reminder.

Money is never computed by the model. Statutory interest and fees for Germany, Austria and Switzerland are calculated in code; a Claude agent writes the letter from verified facts, and a validator rejects any invented amount or premature threat.
Every letter waits in an approval queue. Payments that arrive in the meantime stop the send automatically.

projects.title: Aegis / Meridian
projects.summary: Agentic payments and simulated banking platform with a deterministic double-entry ledger and bounded agent autonomy.
description: Specialised agent squads for onboarding, payment repair, financial-crime investigation, reconciliation and disputes operate on the edge of a deterministic banking core.
Agents act only through typed tools behind a gateway with autonomy levels A0 to A3, kill switches and a human approval inbox.

projects.title: Atlas ERP
projects.summary: Modular ERP for small and mid-sized businesses: finance, inventory, procurement and sales on one platform.
description: Atlas ERP is built as separate domain modules (finance, inventory, procurement, sales) on a shared platform layer, specified in a full product requirements document.

projects.title: Software Factory pipeline
projects.summary: Spec to plan to code to tests with an automatic repair loop: the engine behind every product here.
description: A command-line factory that turns a written spec into a working, tested project. With Claude it plans, writes and repairs code until the tests pass; without a key it produces a clean scaffold.

projects.title: ZAIN LABS website & app
projects.summary: This platform: one content source feeding the website, its API and the iOS/Android app.
description: Designed from Canva templates and built as a Next.js website with a real-time 3D hero and an Expo app for iOS and Android. Both read the same content, so a new project appears everywhere at once.

projects.title: Aesthetic clinic & skin spa sites
projects.summary: Website templates for plastic-surgery clinics and facial spas with booking forms and medical disclaimers.
description: Generated by the website factory from a short brief. Copy avoids outcome guarantees and every page carries the required disclaimer.

projects.title: ZAIN LABS mobile app
projects.summary: The studio in your pocket: every stream, project and release, with an offline cache and a direct line to the team.
description: Built with Expo for iOS and Android from the same design system as the website. Content syncs from the public API and stays available offline.

projects.title: Clinic & spa companion apps
projects.summary: Treatment menus, booking requests and aftercare information for aesthetic clinics and skin studios.
description: Generated by the app factory from a spec: list, form and content screens with a shared theme.

projects.title: Reborn
projects.summary: A music release by Zayn, produced with the studio's AI-assisted music pipeline.
description: Song, cover art and release kit produced in the Studio stream for DACH channels.

projects.title: Last Light
projects.summary: A 12-minute drama: on the last night of her family's cinema, a projectionist finds a message from her late father.
description: Developed with the studio pipeline: bible, treatment, Fountain screenplay, shot list, storyboard prompts and shoot schedule.

projects.title: VideoForge AI
projects.summary: Multi-agent video production: from idea to edited, platform-ready cuts.
description: Specified in a master PRD with a multi-agent architecture for scripting, generation and editing.

projects.title: Autonomous Engineering Orchestrator
projects.summary: An engineering-intelligence system that coordinates domain agents across manufacturing, maintenance and supply chain.
description: Blueprint stage: decision ledger, assumptions register and domain packs designed to be reused across industries.

projects.title: DACH AI & deep-tech ecosystem maps
projects.summary: Research maps of the AI and deep-tech ecosystems in Germany, Austria, Switzerland, Liechtenstein and Luxembourg.
description: Market intelligence that feeds every other stream: who builds what, where, and which programmes support it.
